products.description_id:
[PENGENALAN PRODUK]
AP MAX Coklat Hitam merupakan sepatu boot kerja AP Safety Boots berstandar resmi produksi PT Waru Gunung (Surabaya) dan didistribusikan secara global oleh PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Dibuat menggunakan teknologi direct high-pressure injection molding terpadu tanpa sambungan lem (100% seamless injection), menjamin ketahanan air mutlak, bebas bocor, dan memiliki durabilitas prima di berbagai kondisi pemakaian di Indonesia maupun pasar ekspor.

[MATERIAL & SPESIFIKASI KONSTRUKSI]
• Material Upper: Heavy-Duty PVC / Nitrile Rubber dengan formulasi anti-retak (UV & weather resistant) yang fleksibel mengikuti kontur pergerakan kaki secara ergonomis.
• Material Outsole: Nitrile Blend Anti-Slip Rubber berprofil cleated lug mendalam, memberikan daya cengkeram optimal (SRC Certified (SRA + SRB Heavy Lug Outsole)) di atas lumpur tebal, permukaan basah berair, genangan minyak/oli, dan lantai keramik licin.
• Insole & Kenyamanan: Bantalan insole anatomis penyerap getaran (shock absorption) yang meminimalkan kelelahan kaki saat pemakaian jangka panjang sepanjang hari.
• Dimensi Fisik: Tinggi Profil/Shaft 38.0 cm | Bobot Rata-Rata: 2150 gram per pasang | Pilihan Ukuran: EU 39 - 44.

[FITUR KESELAMATAN & STANDAR KUALITAS]
• Proteksi Utama: Steel Toe Cap 200 Joule, Oil & Chemical Resistant, Grip Sol Anti-Slip S5.
• Proteksi Kaki & Jari: Steel Toe Cap 200 Joule (EN ISO 20345 / ASTM F2413).
• Ketahanan Kimiawi & Cairan: Tahan terhadap paparan oli mineral, pelumas mesin, kotoran hewan ternak, larutan asam/basa encer, serta lumpur gambut perkebunan kelapa sawit.
• Sertifikasi Resmi: Memenuhi Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI 0111:2009), ISO 9001:2015, dan standar mutu pabrik PT Waru Gunung.

[REKOMENDASI APLIKASI]
Sangat ideal digunakan pada sektor: Pertambangan Batubara, Migas, Proyek Sipil Konstruksi Berat, Pabrik Kimia, Peleburan Logam.

[PANDUAN PEMILIHAN UKURAN & PERAWATAN]
• Panduan Ukuran: EU 39 - 44. Disarankan memilih ukuran standar alas kaki harian Anda. Jika memakai kaus kaki tebal, pertimbangkan memilih 1 nomor lebih besar.
• Petunjuk Perawatan: Bersihkan permukaan dengan air mengalir setelah pemakaian. Keringkan di area berventilasi baik dan teduh. Hindari penjemuran langsung di bawah terik matahari agar polimer tetap elastis dan tahan bertahun-tahun.
products.description_en:
[EXECUTIVE PRODUCT OVERVIEW]
AP MAX Coklat Hitam is a industrial AP Safety Boots engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Built utilizing advanced direct high-pressure single-shot injection molding technology, this product provides 100% seamless waterproofing, zero-delamination guarantee, and reliable durability for commercial, institutional, and consumer markets worldwide.

[TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]
• Upper Material: Heavy-Duty PVC / Nitrile Rubber formulated with virgin polymer elastomeric blends for high tensile strength, continuous flex endurance, and crack resistance.
• Outsole Construction: Nitrile Blend Anti-Slip Rubber engineered with heavy self-cleaning cleated lugs and siping channels, achieving certified slip resistance (SRC Certified (SRA + SRB Heavy Lug Outsole)) across oily, greasy, muddy, and wet inclined surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 38.0 cm | Unit Weight: 2150 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 39 - 44.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]
• Impact & Compression Protection: Steel Toe Cap 200 Joule (EN ISO 20345 / ASTM F2413).
• Underfoot Penetration Shield: Steel Midsole Anti-Paku 1100N (Optional on S5).
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

[RECOMMENDED INDUSTRIAL VERTICALS]
Specifically tailored for: Coal Mining, Oil & Gas Rig Operations, Heavy Civil Construction, Chemical Processing Plants, Metal Smelting.

[EXPORT PACKAGING & LOGISTICS CAPABILITIES]
• Master Carton Packaging: Export Grade 5-Ply Corrugated Master Carton, 10 pairs per carton.
• Carton Dimensions: 58 x 42 x 38 cm | Volume: 0.0960 CBM | Gross Weight: 22.50 kg.
• Container Loadability: Approx. 3,600 pairs per 20ft FCL / Approx. 8,500 pairs per 40ft HQ FCL.
• Primary Seaport of Loading: Tanjung Perak Seaport (ID SUB), Surabaya / Tanjung Priok (ID TKG), Jakarta, Indonesia.

products.description_en:

AP Safety S5 BLACK is a industrial AP Safety Boots engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Built utilizing advanced direct high-pressure single-shot injection molding technology, this product provides 100% seamless waterproofing, zero-delamination guarantee, and reliable durability for commercial, institutional, and consumer markets worldwide.

[TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]
• Upper Material: Virgin PVC / Nitrile Blend formulated with virgin polymer elastomeric blends for high tensile strength, continuous flex endurance, and crack resistance.
• Outsole Construction: Nitrile Blend Anti-Slip Rubber engineered with heavy self-cleaning cleated lugs and siping channels, achieving certified slip resistance (SRC Certified (SRA + SRB Heavy Lug Outsole)) across oily, greasy, muddy, and wet inclined surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 38.0 cm | Unit Weight: 2150 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 39 - 44.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]
• Impact & Compression Protection: Steel Toe Cap 200 Joule (EN ISO 20345 / ASTM F2413).
• Underfoot Penetration Shield: Steel Midsole Anti-Paku 1100N (Optional on S5).
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

[RECOMMENDED INDUSTRIAL VERTICALS]
Specifically tailored for: Coal Mining, Oil & Gas Rig Operations, Heavy Civil Construction, Chemical Processing Plants, Metal Smelting.

Dibuat menggunakan teknologi direct high-pressure injection molding terpadu tanpa sambungan lem (100% seamless injection), menjamin ketahanan air mutlak, bebas bocor, dan memiliki durabilitas prima di berbagai kondisi pemakaian di Indonesia maupun pasar ekspor.

[MATERIAL & SPESIFIKASI KONSTRUKSI]
• Material Upper: High-Visibility PVC dengan formulasi anti-retak (UV & weather resistant) yang fleksibel mengikuti kontur pergerakan kaki secara ergonomis.

• Insole & Kenyamanan: Bantalan insole anatomis penyerap getaran (shock absorption) yang meminimalkan kelelahan kaki saat pemakaian jangka panjang sepanjang hari.
• Dimensi Fisik: Tinggi Profil/Shaft 30.0 cm | Bobot Rata-Rata: 1350 gram per pasang | Pilihan Ukuran: EU 38 - 44.

[FITUR KESELAMATAN & STANDAR KUALITAS]
• Proteksi Utama: Standar Keselamatan Pekerja Infrastruktur Jalan Raya & Irigasi.

• Ketahanan Kimiawi & Cairan: Tahan terhadap paparan oli mineral, pelumas mesin, kotoran hewan ternak, larutan asam/basa encer, serta lumpur gambut perkebunan kelapa sawit.
• Sertifikasi Resmi: Memenuhi Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI 0111:2009), ISO 9001:2015, dan standar mutu pabrik PT Waru Gunung.

[REKOMENDASI APLIKASI]
Sangat ideal digunakan pada sektor: Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit, Sawah Padi, Kehutanan, Peternakan Sapi, Irigasi Rawa.

[PANDUAN PEMILIHAN UKURAN & PERAWATAN]
• Panduan Ukuran: EU 38 - 44. Disarankan memilih ukuran standar alas kaki harian Anda. Jika memakai kaus kaki tebal, pertimbangkan memilih 1 nomor lebih besar.

products.description_en:

AP TERRA ECO 3 Orange is a industrial AP Terra Series engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Built utilizing advanced direct high-pressure single-shot injection molding technology, this product provides 100% seamless waterproofing, zero-delamination guarantee, and reliable durability for commercial, institutional, and consumer markets worldwide.

[TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]
• Upper Material: High-Visibility PVC formulated with virgin polymer elastomeric blends for high tensile strength, continuous flex endurance, and crack resistance.
• Outsole Construction: Molded PVC Cleated Sole engineered with heavy self-cleaning cleated lugs and siping channels, achieving certified slip resistance (Self-Cleaning Mud-Release Cleated Lugs) across oily, greasy, muddy, and wet inclined surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 30.0 cm | Unit Weight: 1350 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 38 - 44.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]

• Underfoot Penetration Shield: None (High Flexibility Sole).
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

products.description_id:
[PENGENALAN PRODUK]
AP TERRA 1 Hijau merupakan sepatu boot kerja AP Terra Series berstandar resmi produksi PT Waru Gunung (Surabaya) dan didistribusikan secara global oleh PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Dibuat menggunakan teknologi direct high-pressure injection molding terpadu tanpa sambungan lem (100% seamless injection), menjamin ketahanan air mutlak, bebas bocor, dan memiliki durabilitas prima di berbagai kondisi pemakaian di Indonesia maupun pasar ekspor.

[MATERIAL & SPESIFIKASI KONSTRUKSI]
• Material Upper: Tebal PVC Injeksi dengan formulasi anti-retak (UV & weather resistant) yang fleksibel mengikuti kontur pergerakan kaki secara ergonomis.
• Material Outsole: Molded PVC Cleated Sole berprofil cleated lug mendalam, memberikan daya cengkeram optimal (Self-Cleaning Mud-Release Cleated Lugs) di atas lumpur tebal, permukaan basah berair, genangan minyak/oli, dan lantai keramik licin.
• Insole & Kenyamanan: Bantalan insole anatomis penyerap getaran (shock absorption) yang meminimalkan kelelahan kaki saat pemakaian jangka panjang sepanjang hari.
• Dimensi Fisik: Tinggi Profil/Shaft 30.0 cm | Bobot Rata-Rata: 1350 gram per pasang | Pilihan Ukuran: EU 38 - 43.

[FITUR KESELAMATAN & STANDAR KUALITAS]
• Proteksi Utama: Tahan Jamur, Sol Fleksibel Tidak Mudah Retak di Bawah Terik Matahari.
• Proteksi Kaki & Jari: None (Plain Reinforced Soft Toe).
• Ketahanan Kimiawi & Cairan: Tahan terhadap paparan oli mineral, pelumas mesin, kotoran hewan ternak, larutan asam/basa encer, serta lumpur gambut perkebunan kelapa sawit.
• Sertifikasi Resmi: Memenuhi Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI 0111:2009), ISO 9001:2015, dan standar mutu pabrik PT Waru Gunung.

[REKOMENDASI APLIKASI]
Sangat ideal digunakan pada sektor: Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit, Sawah Padi, Kehutanan, Peternakan Sapi, Irigasi Rawa.

[PANDUAN PEMILIHAN UKURAN & PERAWATAN]
• Panduan Ukuran: EU 38 - 43. Disarankan memilih ukuran standar alas kaki harian Anda. Jika memakai kaus kaki tebal, pertimbangkan memilih 1 nomor lebih besar.
• Petunjuk Perawatan: Bersihkan permukaan dengan air mengalir setelah pemakaian. Keringkan di area berventilasi baik dan teduh. Hindari penjemuran langsung di bawah terik matahari agar polimer tetap elastis dan tahan bertahun-tahun.
products.description_en:
[EXECUTIVE PRODUCT OVERVIEW]
AP TERRA 1 Hijau is a industrial AP Terra Series engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Built utilizing advanced direct high-pressure single-shot injection molding technology, this product provides 100% seamless waterproofing, zero-delamination guarantee, and reliable durability for commercial, institutional, and consumer markets worldwide.

[TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]
• Upper Material: Tebal PVC Injeksi formulated with virgin polymer elastomeric blends for high tensile strength, continuous flex endurance, and crack resistance.
• Outsole Construction: Molded PVC Cleated Sole engineered with heavy self-cleaning cleated lugs and siping channels, achieving certified slip resistance (Self-Cleaning Mud-Release Cleated Lugs) across oily, greasy, muddy, and wet inclined surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 30.0 cm | Unit Weight: 1350 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 38 - 43.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]
• Impact & Compression Protection: None (Plain Reinforced Soft Toe).
• Underfoot Penetration Shield: None (High Flexibility Sole).
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

[RECOMMENDED INDUSTRIAL VERTICALS]
Specifically tailored for: Oil Palm & Rubber Plantations, Rice Farming, Forestry, Cattle Livestock, Wet Marshland Irrigation.

[EXPORT PACKAGING & LOGISTICS CAPABILITIES]
• Master Carton Packaging: Export Grade 5-Ply Corrugated Master Carton, 12 pairs per carton.
• Carton Dimensions: 58 x 42 x 38 cm | Volume: 0.0960 CBM | Gross Weight: 17.50 kg.
• Container Loadability: Approx. 3,600 pairs per 20ft FCL / Approx. 8,500 pairs per 40ft HQ FCL.
• Primary Seaport of Loading: Tanjung Perak Seaport (ID SUB), Surabaya / Tanjung Priok (ID TKG), Jakarta, Indonesia.

products.description_id:
[PENGENALAN PRODUK]
AP TERRA 3 HITAM KUNING merupakan sepatu boot kerja AP Terra Series berstandar resmi produksi PT Waru Gunung (Surabaya) dan didistribusikan secara global oleh PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Dibuat menggunakan teknologi direct high-pressure injection molding terpadu tanpa sambungan lem (100% seamless injection), menjamin ketahanan air mutlak, bebas bocor, dan memiliki durabilitas prima di berbagai kondisi pemakaian di Indonesia maupun pasar ekspor.

[MATERIAL & SPESIFIKASI KONSTRUKSI]
• Material Upper: Heavy Duty PVC dengan formulasi anti-retak (UV & weather resistant) yang fleksibel mengikuti kontur pergerakan kaki secara ergonomis.
• Material Outsole: Molded PVC Cleated Sole berprofil cleated lug mendalam, memberikan daya cengkeram optimal (Self-Cleaning Mud-Release Cleated Lugs) di atas lumpur tebal, permukaan basah berair, genangan minyak/oli, dan lantai keramik licin.
• Insole & Kenyamanan: Bantalan insole anatomis penyerap getaran (shock absorption) yang meminimalkan kelelahan kaki saat pemakaian jangka panjang sepanjang hari.
• Dimensi Fisik: Tinggi Profil/Shaft 30.0 cm | Bobot Rata-Rata: 1350 gram per pasang | Pilihan Ukuran: EU 38 - 44.

[FITUR KESELAMATAN & STANDAR KUALITAS]
• Proteksi Utama: Paling Populer di Perkebunan Karet dan Kelapa Sawit Sumatera.
• Proteksi Kaki & Jari: None (Plain Reinforced Soft Toe).
• Ketahanan Kimiawi & Cairan: Tahan terhadap paparan oli mineral, pelumas mesin, kotoran hewan ternak, larutan asam/basa encer, serta lumpur gambut perkebunan kelapa sawit.
• Sertifikasi Resmi: Memenuhi Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI 0111:2009), ISO 9001:2015, dan standar mutu pabrik PT Waru Gunung.

[REKOMENDASI APLIKASI]
Sangat ideal digunakan pada sektor: Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit, Sawah Padi, Kehutanan, Peternakan Sapi, Irigasi Rawa.

[PANDUAN PEMILIHAN UKURAN & PERAWATAN]
• Panduan Ukuran: EU 38 - 44. Disarankan memilih ukuran standar alas kaki harian Anda. Jika memakai kaus kaki tebal, pertimbangkan memilih 1 nomor lebih besar.
• Petunjuk Perawatan: Bersihkan permukaan dengan air mengalir setelah pemakaian. Keringkan di area berventilasi baik dan teduh. Hindari penjemuran langsung di bawah terik matahari agar polimer tetap elastis dan tahan bertahun-tahun.
products.description_en:
[EXECUTIVE PRODUCT OVERVIEW]
AP TERRA 3 HITAM KUNING is a industrial AP Terra Series engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Built utilizing advanced direct high-pressure single-shot injection molding technology, this product provides 100% seamless waterproofing, zero-delamination guarantee, and reliable durability for commercial, institutional, and consumer markets worldwide.

[TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]
• Upper Material: Heavy Duty PVC formulated with virgin polymer elastomeric blends for high tensile strength, continuous flex endurance, and crack resistance.
• Outsole Construction: Molded PVC Cleated Sole engineered with heavy self-cleaning cleated lugs and siping channels, achieving certified slip resistance (Self-Cleaning Mud-Release Cleated Lugs) across oily, greasy, muddy, and wet inclined surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 30.0 cm | Unit Weight: 1350 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 38 - 44.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]
• Impact & Compression Protection: None (Plain Reinforced Soft Toe).
• Underfoot Penetration Shield: None (High Flexibility Sole).
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

[RECOMMENDED INDUSTRIAL VERTICALS]
Specifically tailored for: Oil Palm & Rubber Plantations, Rice Farming, Forestry, Cattle Livestock, Wet Marshland Irrigation.

[EXPORT PACKAGING & LOGISTICS CAPABILITIES]
• Master Carton Packaging: Export Grade 5-Ply Corrugated Master Carton, 12 pairs per carton.
• Carton Dimensions: 58 x 42 x 38 cm | Volume: 0.0960 CBM | Gross Weight: 17.50 kg.
• Container Loadability: Approx. 3,600 pairs per 20ft FCL / Approx. 8,500 pairs per 40ft HQ FCL.
• Primary Seaport of Loading: Tanjung Perak Seaport (ID SUB), Surabaya / Tanjung Priok (ID TKG), Jakarta, Indonesia.

[PENGENALAN PRODUK]
AP ALLBIKE 2 HIJAU merupakan sepatu boot pengendara motor & kurir tahan air berstandar resmi produksi PT Waru Gunung (Surabaya) dan didistribusikan secara global oleh PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Dibuat menggunakan teknologi direct high-pressure injection molding terpadu tanpa sambungan lem (100% seamless injection), menjamin ketahanan air mutlak, bebas bocor, dan memiliki durabilitas prima di berbagai kondisi pemakaian di Indonesia maupun pasar ekspor.

[MATERIAL & SPESIFIKASI KONSTRUKSI]
• Material Upper: High Grip PVC Sole dengan formulasi anti-retak (UV & weather resistant) yang fleksibel mengikuti kontur pergerakan kaki secara ergonomis.
• Material Outsole: Molded PVC Cleated Sole berprofil cleated lug mendalam, memberikan daya cengkeram optimal (Grooved Rain Water-Dispersion Sole) di atas lumpur tebal, permukaan basah berair, genangan minyak/oli, dan lantai keramik licin.
• Insole & Kenyamanan: Bantalan insole anatomis penyerap getaran (shock absorption) yang meminimalkan kelelahan kaki saat pemakaian jangka panjang sepanjang hari.
• Dimensi Fisik: Tinggi Profil/Shaft 21.0 cm | Bobot Rata-Rata: 860 gram per pasang | Pilihan Ukuran: EU 38 - 43.

[FITUR KESELAMATAN & STANDAR KUALITAS]
• Proteksi Utama: Sol Cengkeram Karet Basah, Aman Menginjak Aspal Licin.
• Proteksi Kaki & Jari: None (Ankle Guard Protection).
• Ketahanan Kimiawi & Cairan: Tahan terhadap paparan oli mineral, pelumas mesin, kotoran hewan ternak, larutan asam/basa encer, serta lumpur gambut perkebunan kelapa sawit.
• Sertifikasi Resmi: Memenuhi Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI 0111:2009), ISO 9001:2015, dan standar mutu pabrik PT Waru Gunung.

[REKOMENDASI APLIKASI]
Sangat ideal digunakan pada sektor: Kurir Logistik Ekspedisi, Pengendara Sepeda Motor Harian, Komuter Hujan, Touring.

[PANDUAN PEMILIHAN UKURAN & PERAWATAN]
• Panduan Ukuran: EU 38 - 43. Disarankan memilih ukuran standar alas kaki harian Anda. Jika memakai kaus kaki tebal, pertimbangkan memilih 1 nomor lebih besar.
• Petunjuk Perawatan: Bersihkan permukaan dengan air mengalir setelah pemakaian. Keringkan di area berventilasi baik dan teduh. Hindari penjemuran langsung di bawah terik matahari agar polimer tetap elastis dan tahan bertahun-tahun.
products.description_en:
[EXECUTIVE PRODUCT OVERVIEW]
AP ALLBIKE 2 HIJAU is a waterproof PVC motorcycle riding & commuter boots engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Built utilizing advanced direct high-pressure single-shot injection molding technology, this product provides 100% seamless waterproofing, zero-delamination guarantee, and reliable durability for commercial, institutional, and consumer markets worldwide.

[TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]
• Upper Material: High Grip PVC Sole formulated with virgin polymer elastomeric blends for high tensile strength, continuous flex endurance, and crack resistance.
• Outsole Construction: Molded PVC Cleated Sole engineered with heavy self-cleaning cleated lugs and siping channels, achieving certified slip resistance (Grooved Rain Water-Dispersion Sole) across oily, greasy, muddy, and wet inclined surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 21.0 cm | Unit Weight: 860 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 38 - 43.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]
• Impact & Compression Protection: None (Ankle Guard Protection).
• Underfoot Penetration Shield: None (Footpeg Gripping Sole).
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

[RECOMMENDED INDUSTRIAL VERTICALS]
Specifically tailored for: Express Courier Logistics, Motorbike Commuters, Monsoon Road Traveling.

[EXPORT PACKAGING & LOGISTICS CAPABILITIES]
• Master Carton Packaging: Export Grade 5-Ply Corrugated Master Carton, 12 pairs per carton.
• Carton Dimensions: 58 x 42 x 38 cm | Volume: 0.0960 CBM | Gross Weight: 12.50 kg.
• Container Loadability: Approx. 3,600 pairs per 20ft FCL / Approx. 8,500 pairs per 40ft HQ FCL.
• Primary Seaport of Loading: Tanjung Perak Seaport (ID SUB), Surabaya / Tanjung Priok (ID TKG), Jakarta, Indonesia.

products.description_id:
[PENGENALAN PRODUK]
AP Boots 2006 merupakan sepatu boot kerja AP Classic Boots berstandar resmi produksi PT Waru Gunung (Surabaya) dan didistribusikan secara global oleh PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Dibuat menggunakan teknologi direct high-pressure injection molding terpadu tanpa sambungan lem (100% seamless injection), menjamin ketahanan air mutlak, bebas bocor, dan memiliki durabilitas prima di berbagai kondisi pemakaian di Indonesia maupun pasar ekspor.

[MATERIAL & SPESIFIKASI KONSTRUKSI]
• Material Upper: Traditional Heavy PVC dengan formulasi anti-retak (UV & weather resistant) yang fleksibel mengikuti kontur pergerakan kaki secara ergonomis.
• Material Outsole: Molded PVC Cleated Sole berprofil cleated lug mendalam, memberikan daya cengkeram optimal (Deep Cleat Tractor Tread) di atas lumpur tebal, permukaan basah berair, genangan minyak/oli, dan lantai keramik licin.
• Insole & Kenyamanan: Bantalan insole anatomis penyerap getaran (shock absorption) yang meminimalkan kelelahan kaki saat pemakaian jangka panjang sepanjang hari.
• Dimensi Fisik: Tinggi Profil/Shaft 36.0 cm | Bobot Rata-Rata: 1450 gram per pasang | Pilihan Ukuran: EU 38 - 43.

[FITUR KESELAMATAN & STANDAR KUALITAS]
• Proteksi Utama: Desain Klasik Tanpa Ribet, Cukup Disemprot Air Langsung Bersih.
• Proteksi Kaki & Jari: None (Heavy PVC Reinforced Toe).
• Ketahanan Kimiawi & Cairan: Tahan terhadap paparan oli mineral, pelumas mesin, kotoran hewan ternak, larutan asam/basa encer, serta lumpur gambut perkebunan kelapa sawit.
• Sertifikasi Resmi: Memenuhi Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI 0111:2009), ISO 9001:2015, dan standar mutu pabrik PT Waru Gunung.

[REKOMENDASI APLIKASI]
Sangat ideal digunakan pada sektor: Penanganan Banjir Musiman, Dinas Kebersihan & Sanitasi Kota, Pekerjaan Rumah Tangga, Got & Saluran Air.

[PANDUAN PEMILIHAN UKURAN & PERAWATAN]
• Panduan Ukuran: EU 38 - 43. Disarankan memilih ukuran standar alas kaki harian Anda. Jika memakai kaus kaki tebal, pertimbangkan memilih 1 nomor lebih besar.
• Petunjuk Perawatan: Bersihkan permukaan dengan air mengalir setelah pemakaian. Keringkan di area berventilasi baik dan teduh. Hindari penjemuran langsung di bawah terik matahari agar polimer tetap elastis dan tahan bertahun-tahun.
products.description_en:

AP Boots 2006 is a industrial AP Classic Boots engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). [TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]

• Outsole Construction: Molded PVC Cleated Sole engineered with heavy self-cleaning cleated lugs and siping channels, achieving certified slip resistance (Deep Cleat Tractor Tread) across oily, greasy, muddy, and wet inclined surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 36.0 cm | Unit Weight: 1450 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 38 - 43.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]
• Impact & Compression Protection: None (Heavy PVC Reinforced Toe).
• Underfoot Penetration Shield: None.
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

[RECOMMENDED INDUSTRIAL VERTICALS]
Specifically tailored for: Municipal Flood Relief, Urban Sanitation, Drain Cleaning, General Monsoon Utility.

[EXPORT PACKAGING & LOGISTICS CAPABILITIES]
• Master Carton Packaging: Export Grade 5-Ply Corrugated Master Carton, 12 pairs per carton.

• Container Loadability: Approx. 3,600 pairs per 20ft FCL / Approx. 8,500 pairs per 40ft HQ FCL.
• Primary Seaport of Loading: Tanjung Perak Seaport (ID SUB), Surabaya / Tanjung Priok (ID TKG), Jakarta, Indonesia.

[PENGENALAN PRODUK]
AP KIDS 2012 LEMON POLKADOT merupakan sepatu boot hujan anak tahan air dan ringan berstandar resmi produksi PT Waru Gunung (Surabaya) dan didistribusikan secara global oleh PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Dibuat menggunakan teknologi direct high-pressure injection molding terpadu tanpa sambungan lem (100% seamless injection), menjamin ketahanan air mutlak, bebas bocor, dan memiliki durabilitas prima di berbagai kondisi pemakaian di Indonesia maupun pasar ekspor.

[MATERIAL & SPESIFIKASI KONSTRUKSI]
• Material Upper: Printed PVC Bebas Timbal dengan formulasi anti-retak (UV & weather resistant) yang fleksibel mengikuti kontur pergerakan kaki secara ergonomis.
• Material Outsole: Molded PVC Cleated Sole ergonomis anti-slip (Wave Texture Non-Marking Sole) untuk daya cengkeram stabil di lantai basah, keramik, dan permukaan harian.
• Insole & Kenyamanan: Bantalan insole anatomis penyerap getaran (shock absorption) yang meminimalkan kelelahan kaki saat pemakaian jangka panjang sepanjang hari.
• Dimensi Fisik: Tinggi Profil/Shaft 20.0 cm | Bobot Rata-Rata: 520 gram per pasang | Pilihan Ukuran: EU 27 - 34.

[FITUR KESELAMATAN & STANDAR KUALITAS]
• Proteksi Utama: Motif Bintik Ceria Favorit Anak Perempuan, Mudah Dibersihkan.
• Proteksi Kaki & Jari: Soft Flexible Rounded Toe (Phthalate Free).
• Ketahanan Air & Perawatan Mudah: 100% tahan air, mudah dicuci/disterilkan, cepat kering, serta tahan terhadap paparan cairan harian dan deterjen ringan.
• Sertifikasi Resmi: Memenuhi Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI 0111:2009), ISO 9001:2015, dan standar mutu pabrik PT Waru Gunung.

[REKOMENDASI APLIKASI]
Sangat ideal digunakan pada sektor: Anak Sekolah Musim Hujan, Aktivitas Luar Ruangan Taman, Bermain Genangan Air Bersih.

[PANDUAN PEMILIHAN UKURAN & PERAWATAN]
• Panduan Ukuran: EU 27 - 34. Disarankan memilih ukuran standar alas kaki harian Anda. Jika memakai kaus kaki tebal, pertimbangkan memilih 1 nomor lebih besar.

products.description_en:
[EXECUTIVE PRODUCT OVERVIEW]
AP KIDS 2012 LEMON POLKADOT is a lightweight waterproof PVC children's rain boots engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Built utilizing advanced direct high-pressure single-shot injection molding technology, this product provides 100% seamless waterproofing, zero-delamination guarantee, and reliable durability for commercial, institutional, and consumer markets worldwide.

[TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]
• Upper Material: Printed PVC Bebas Timbal formulated with virgin polymer elastomeric blends for high tensile strength, continuous flex endurance, and crack resistance.
• Outsole Construction: Molded PVC Cleated Sole engineered with ergonomic anti-slip tread geometry, achieving reliable slip resistance (Wave Texture Non-Marking Sole) across wet tiles, smooth floors, and daily commercial surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 20.0 cm | Unit Weight: 520 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 27 - 34.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]
• Impact & Compression Protection: Soft Flexible Rounded Toe (Phthalate Free).
• Underfoot Penetration Shield: None.
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

[RECOMMENDED APPLICATIONS]
Specifically tailored for: School Commuters, Outdoor Parks, Children Rainy Season Play.

[EXPORT PACKAGING & LOGISTICS CAPABILITIES]
• Master Carton Packaging: Export Grade 5-Ply Corrugated Master Carton, 12 pairs per carton.
• Carton Dimensions: 58 x 42 x 38 cm | Volume: 0.0960 CBM | Gross Weight: 8.50 kg.
• Container Loadability: Approx. 3,600 pairs per 20ft FCL / Approx. 8,500 pairs per 40ft HQ FCL.
• Primary Seaport of Loading: Tanjung Perak Seaport (ID SUB), Surabaya / Tanjung Priok (ID TKG), Jakarta, Indonesia.

Petrova Sepatu Boots Phenom Yellow PVC Steel Toe Cap Anti Static merupakan sepatu boot kerja Petrova Heavy Duty Safety berstandar resmi produksi PT Waru Gunung (Surabaya) dan didistribusikan secara global oleh PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Dibuat menggunakan teknologi direct high-pressure injection molding terpadu tanpa sambungan lem (100% seamless injection), menjamin ketahanan air mutlak, bebas bocor, dan memiliki durabilitas prima di berbagai kondisi pemakaian di Indonesia maupun pasar ekspor.

[MATERIAL & SPESIFIKASI KONSTRUKSI]
• Material Upper: Reinforced PVC Compound dengan formulasi anti-retak (UV & weather resistant) yang fleksibel mengikuti kontur pergerakan kaki secara ergonomis.
• Material Outsole: Nitrile Rubber Heavy Lug Anti-Puncture Sole berprofil cleated lug mendalam, memberikan daya cengkeram optimal (Deep Tractor Lug Nitrile Sole (SRC Oil & Chemical Resistant)) di atas lumpur tebal, permukaan basah berair, genangan minyak/oli, dan lantai keramik licin.
• Insole & Kenyamanan: Bantalan insole anatomis penyerap getaran (shock absorption) yang meminimalkan kelelahan kaki saat pemakaian jangka panjang sepanjang hari.
• Dimensi Fisik: Tinggi Profil/Shaft 38.0 cm | Bobot Rata-Rata: 2250 gram per pasang | Pilihan Ukuran: EU 38 - 45.

[FITUR KESELAMATAN & STANDAR KUALITAS]
• Proteksi Utama: Steel Toe Cap 200J, Oil & Acid Resistant, Waterproof S5, Anti-Slip Cleated.
• Proteksi Kaki & Jari: Heavy-Duty Steel Toe Cap 200J (EN ISO 20345 S5).
• Ketahanan Kimiawi & Cairan: Tahan terhadap paparan oli mineral, pelumas mesin, kotoran hewan ternak, larutan asam/basa encer, serta lumpur gambut perkebunan kelapa sawit.
• Sertifikasi Resmi: Memenuhi Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI 0111:2009), ISO 9001:2015, dan standar mutu pabrik PT Waru Gunung.

[REKOMENDASI APLIKASI]
Sangat ideal digunakan pada sektor: Pertambangan Tambang Terbuka, Galangan Kapal, Kilang Minyak, Pengecoran Logam, Konstruksi Jalan Tol.

[PANDUAN PEMILIHAN UKURAN & PERAWATAN]
• Panduan Ukuran: EU 38 - 45. Disarankan memilih ukuran standar alas kaki harian Anda. Jika memakai kaus kaki tebal, pertimbangkan memilih 1 nomor lebih besar.
• Petunjuk Perawatan: Bersihkan permukaan dengan air mengalir setelah pemakaian. Keringkan di area berventilasi baik dan teduh. Hindari penjemuran langsung di bawah terik matahari agar polimer tetap elastis dan tahan bertahun-tahun.
products.description_en:
[EXECUTIVE PRODUCT OVERVIEW]
Petrova Sepatu Boots Phenom Yellow PVC Steel Toe Cap Anti Static is a industrial Petrova Heavy Duty Safety engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Built utilizing advanced direct high-pressure single-shot injection molding technology, this product provides 100% seamless waterproofing, zero-delamination guarantee, and reliable durability for commercial, institutional, and consumer markets worldwide.

[TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]
• Upper Material: Reinforced PVC Compound formulated with virgin polymer elastomeric blends for high tensile strength, continuous flex endurance, and crack resistance.
• Outsole Construction: Nitrile Rubber Heavy Lug Anti-Puncture Sole engineered with heavy self-cleaning cleated lugs and siping channels, achieving certified slip resistance (Deep Tractor Lug Nitrile Sole (SRC Oil & Chemical Resistant)) across oily, greasy, muddy, and wet inclined surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 38.0 cm | Unit Weight: 2250 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 38 - 45.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]
• Impact & Compression Protection: Heavy-Duty Steel Toe Cap 200J (EN ISO 20345 S5).
• Underfoot Penetration Shield: Steel Midsole Plate 1100N (Puncture Proof).
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

[RECOMMENDED INDUSTRIAL VERTICALS]
Specifically tailored for: Open-Pit Mining, Heavy Shipyards, Oil Refineries, Heavy Road Construction, Steel Foundries.

[EXPORT PACKAGING & LOGISTICS CAPABILITIES]
• Master Carton Packaging: Export Grade 5-Ply Corrugated Master Carton, 10 pairs per carton.
• Carton Dimensions: 58 x 42 x 38 cm | Volume: 0.0960 CBM | Gross Weight: 23.50 kg.
• Container Loadability: Approx. 3,600 pairs per 20ft FCL / Approx. 8,500 pairs per 40ft HQ FCL.
• Primary Seaport of Loading: Tanjung Perak Seaport (ID SUB), Surabaya / Tanjung Priok (ID TKG), Jakarta, Indonesia.

products.description_id:
[PENGENALAN PRODUK]
Petrova Sepatu Boots Strength WB Hitam Boots Air PVC merupakan sepatu boot kerja Petrova Heavy Duty Safety berstandar resmi produksi PT Waru Gunung (Surabaya) dan didistribusikan secara global oleh PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Dibuat menggunakan teknologi direct high-pressure injection molding terpadu tanpa sambungan lem (100% seamless injection), menjamin ketahanan air mutlak, bebas bocor, dan memiliki durabilitas prima di berbagai kondisi pemakaian di Indonesia maupun pasar ekspor.

[MATERIAL & SPESIFIKASI KONSTRUKSI]
• Material Upper: Reinforced PVC Compound dengan formulasi anti-retak (UV & weather resistant) yang fleksibel mengikuti kontur pergerakan kaki secara ergonomis.
• Material Outsole: Nitrile Rubber Heavy Lug Anti-Puncture Sole berprofil cleated lug mendalam, memberikan daya cengkeram optimal (Deep Tractor Lug Nitrile Sole (SRC Oil & Chemical Resistant)) di atas lumpur tebal, permukaan basah berair, genangan minyak/oli, dan lantai keramik licin.
• Insole & Kenyamanan: Bantalan insole anatomis penyerap getaran (shock absorption) yang meminimalkan kelelahan kaki saat pemakaian jangka panjang sepanjang hari.
• Dimensi Fisik: Tinggi Profil/Shaft 38.0 cm | Bobot Rata-Rata: 2250 gram per pasang | Pilihan Ukuran: EU 38 - 45.

[FITUR KESELAMATAN & STANDAR KUALITAS]
• Proteksi Utama: Steel Toe Cap 200J, Oil & Acid Resistant, Waterproof S5, Anti-Slip Cleated.
• Proteksi Kaki & Jari: Heavy-Duty Steel Toe Cap 200J (EN ISO 20345 S5).
• Ketahanan Kimiawi & Cairan: Tahan terhadap paparan oli mineral, pelumas mesin, kotoran hewan ternak, larutan asam/basa encer, serta lumpur gambut perkebunan kelapa sawit.
• Sertifikasi Resmi: Memenuhi Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI 0111:2009), ISO 9001:2015, dan standar mutu pabrik PT Waru Gunung.

[REKOMENDASI APLIKASI]
Sangat ideal digunakan pada sektor: Pertambangan Tambang Terbuka, Galangan Kapal, Kilang Minyak, Pengecoran Logam, Konstruksi Jalan Tol.

[PANDUAN PEMILIHAN UKURAN & PERAWATAN]
• Panduan Ukuran: EU 38 - 45. Disarankan memilih ukuran standar alas kaki harian Anda. Jika memakai kaus kaki tebal, pertimbangkan memilih 1 nomor lebih besar.
• Petunjuk Perawatan: Bersihkan permukaan dengan air mengalir setelah pemakaian. Keringkan di area berventilasi baik dan teduh. Hindari penjemuran langsung di bawah terik matahari agar polimer tetap elastis dan tahan bertahun-tahun.
products.description_en:
[EXECUTIVE PRODUCT OVERVIEW]
Petrova Sepatu Boots Strength WB Hitam Boots Air PVC is a industrial Petrova Heavy Duty Safety engineered by PT Waru Gunung and distributed internationally by PT Indo Sukses Semesta (HOTS Trading). Built utilizing advanced direct high-pressure single-shot injection molding technology, this product provides 100% seamless waterproofing, zero-delamination guarantee, and reliable durability for commercial, institutional, and consumer markets worldwide.

[TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS MATRIX]
• Upper Material: Reinforced PVC Compound formulated with virgin polymer elastomeric blends for high tensile strength, continuous flex endurance, and crack resistance.
• Outsole Construction: Nitrile Rubber Heavy Lug Anti-Puncture Sole engineered with heavy self-cleaning cleated lugs and siping channels, achieving certified slip resistance (Deep Tractor Lug Nitrile Sole (SRC Oil & Chemical Resistant)) across oily, greasy, muddy, and wet inclined surfaces.
• Comfort Architecture: Anatomical shock-absorbing footbed with quick-drying interior support to mitigate moisture build-up and foot fatigue during prolonged wear.
• Physical Parameters: Profile/Shaft Height: 38.0 cm | Unit Weight: 2250 g/pair | Sizing Range: EU 38 - 45.

[SAFETY SPECIFICATIONS & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE]
• Impact & Compression Protection: Heavy-Duty Steel Toe Cap 200J (EN ISO 20345 S5).
• Underfoot Penetration Shield: Steel Midsole Plate 1100N (Puncture Proof).
• Quality Assurance Standards: Complies with SNI 0111:2009, ISO 9001:2015, and GPSR EU 2023/988 quality criteria.
• Material & Environmental Defense: High resistance against water, mild detergents, mineral oils, and everyday surface wear.

[RECOMMENDED INDUSTRIAL VERTICALS]
Specifically tailored for: Open-Pit Mining, Heavy Shipyards, Oil Refineries, Heavy Road Construction, Steel Foundries.

[EXPORT PACKAGING & LOGISTICS CAPABILITIES]
• Master Carton Packaging: Export Grade 5-Ply Corrugated Master Carton, 10 pairs per carton.
• Carton Dimensions: 58 x 42 x 38 cm | Volume: 0.0960 CBM | Gross Weight: 23.50 kg.
• Container Loadability: Approx. 3,600 pairs per 20ft FCL / Approx. 8,500 pairs per 40ft HQ FCL.
• Primary Seaport of Loading: Tanjung Perak Seaport (ID SUB), Surabaya / Tanjung Priok (ID TKG), Jakarta, Indonesia.
